objective: Measure whether experiment selection and stopping policies improve intervention utility and mechanism recovery at equal experimental budgets, rather than maximizing information gain or final answer confidence in isolation.
primary_estimands: paired difference in accepted outcome versus the official upstream-compatible agent
paired difference in benefit_recovered and intervention regret

policy_arms.name: Official ACED agent
policy_arms.role: Primary external reference; preserve upstream prompt, tool contract, budget and grader where licensing and execution permit.

policy_arms.name: Random valid intervention
policy_arms.role: Control for unguided exploration; sample only within declared valid actuator and dose bounds.

policy_arms.name: Greedy expected information gain
policy_arms.role: Select the affordable experiment with greatest expected reduction in uncertainty over a preregistered hypothesis/mechanism posterior.

policy_arms.name: Expected value of sample information
policy_arms.role: Select the experiment with greatest expected improvement in downstream decision utility after observing its result, net of declared experiment cost.

policy_arms.name: Risk-adjusted EVSI
policy_arms.role: Subtract intervention hazard, irreversibility and subgroup downside using predeclared loss terms; use safe read-only measurements where intervention risk is material.

policy_arms.name: Adaptive evidence-gated selector
policy_arms.role: Choose among measurement, intervention, replication, dose search, subgroup probe, clarification and stop based on evidence state, decision sensitivity and remaining budget. No oracle access.

design_controls.matched_unit: Same pinned world, model snapshot, system prompt, tool schema, serving context, decoding settings, token budget, 15-experiment limit and 32-turn limit within each paired comparison.
design_controls.randomization: Randomize arm execution order and model-call order within each world; keep all treatments for one world in the same statistical cluster.
design_controls.seeds: Precommit world, intervention-sampling, agent and evaluation seeds; include them in a receipt before model execution.
design_controls.information_boundary: The candidate receives only the scenario and tool outputs. It never receives the hidden SCM, true intervention, oracle dose, battery/scoring roles, or the split index.
design_controls.no_hindsight: Record predicted outcome distributions and expected information/value before every experiment; never backfill predictions after observing outcomes.
design_controls.stopping: A stop must bind the evidence state and current best action. Evaluate expected marginal value of the best available additional experiment after cost and risk; retain abstain/unknown when decision value is unresolved.
design_controls.official_score: Never alter the official ACED grader or official metric definitions. New metrics remain a separate scorecard.

required_scenario_families: one experiment is highly informative about a non-decisive variable
a low-entropy experiment changes the optimal intervention
a confounded observational correlation is overturned by a targeted intervention
multiple independent causes require more than one effective lever
the correct actuator is found but the optimal dose lies in a narrow window
synergistic effects require a joint intervention
a surrogate/instrument measurement is informative but not directly actionable
subgroup effects reverse the population-average policy
new contradictory evidence requires replication or source reconciliation
all remaining experiments have negative expected net decision value
one remaining experiment has high value only for a minority subgroup
an intervention can cause irreversible or high-cost harm

metrics.name: benefit_recovered
metrics.definition: Preserve official ACED ratio of improvement versus oracle fix.

metrics.name: intervention_regret
metrics.definition: Difference between true objective under chosen intervention and oracle objective.

metrics.name: utility_auc_budget
metrics.definition: Area under best-achieved true utility as a function of experiment count; evaluated by hidden oracle after run.

metrics.name: expected_value_calibration
metrics.definition: Proper-score/calibration comparison of pre-registered predicted experiment value versus realized decision-relevant value where estimable.

metrics.name: decision_relevant_information
metrics.definition: Change in optimal downstream action or expected utility attributable to an observation, distinct from generic entropy reduction.

metrics.name: premature_stop_regret
metrics.definition: Counterfactual decision regret when the agent stops while at least one affordable experiment has positive net expected decision value.

metrics.name: unnecessary_experiment_cost
metrics.definition: Declared experiment cost incurred after further evidence cannot improve the decision beyond a preregistered materiality threshold.

metrics.name: experiment_efficiency
metrics.definition: Benefit recovered or regret reduction per experiment, turn, tool call, token and unit cost.

metrics.name: worst_group_regret
metrics.definition: Maximum subgroup/domain/archetype regret; prevents average gains from hiding fragile policies.

metrics.name: unsupported_mechanism_claim_rate
metrics.definition: Rate of mechanism claims not supported by the observations/interventions available before commitment.

statistical_plan.primary_unit: World-level matched paired difference; all seeds and repeated model runs remain clustered by upstream world identity.
statistical_plan.reporting: Per-world raw results, paired mean/median, confidence intervals, effect sizes, complete denominators, missing/timeout/invalid cases and per-archetype/per-domain results.
statistical_plan.multiplicity: Predeclare primary outcomes and control family-wise error or false discovery for secondary subgroup comparisons.
statistical_plan.sample_size: The 54-world upstream evaluation set is an initial external evaluation, not automatically powered for every domain subgroup. Confirmatory work must use a preregistered power analysis and account for only five or six eval worlds in most domains.
statistical_plan.independence: Do not treat the evaluation subset and parent test inventory as independent samples.

claim_ceiling: This protocol proposes matched experiment-selection and stopping comparisons. No policy arm has been run here. No EVSI advantage, SOTA superiority, safety or causal reasoning competence is claimed.

methods.objective: Expected reduction in predictive uncertainty, measured in bits. It is deliberately not combined arithmetically with utility-valued experiment costs.
methods.known_limitation: Measures uncertainty reduction, not whether learning changes the best action; a bit-valued score is not commensurable with utility without a separately calibrated conversion.

methods.objective: Expected improvement in optimal downstream action utility after an observation, minus experiment cost, both measured in the declared utility scale.
methods.known_limitation: Does not account for intervention risk unless a separate risk term is added.

methods.objective: Expected improvement in optimal downstream action utility minus experiment cost and a preregistered risk-aversion coefficient times experiment risk.
methods.known_limitation: The coefficient and risk measure are task-specific assumptions and must be declared before trial execution.

executable_reference_selector.counterexample: Three hypotheses have prior [0.45, 0.45, 0.10]. Two hypotheses recommend the same action; the low-probability third hypothesis recommends another action. A probe that separates the first two hypotheses reduces entropy but does not change the optimal action. A noisier signal that discriminates the third hypothesis has lower entropy gain but positive decision value. A perfect-information intervention can have higher raw EVSI but be rejected when its declared risk penalty exceeds its value.
negative_controls: negative net value returns stop/no experiment
risk-adjusted EVSI rejects the high-risk perfect-information experiment in the synthetic counterexample
executable_reference_selector.claim_ceiling: Purely synthetic algorithmic reference and unit tests. No ACED worlds, hidden world payloads, external data, model calls or human evaluations are executed by this module.

selection_score_units.comparison_rule: Compare candidates only within the same selection method and declared unit system. Do not rank EIG bits directly against EVSI utility scores.

event_types.experiment_proposal: Pre-observation commitment to belief digest, selector, predicted outcomes, EIG in bits, EVSI in utility, risk, risk-aversion coefficient, cost in utility, and selector-specific predicted_selection_score. EIG score is EIG bits; EVSI score is EVSI minus cost; risk-adjusted EVSI score is EVSI minus cost minus risk-aversion coefficient times risk.
event_types.experiment_observation: Append-only later record referencing exactly one proposal event, with observed/failed/unknown status, evaluator-resolved outcome class and output digest when observed, and actual cost. Failed/unknown attempts remain in the event log but are excluded from proper-score denominators.
event_types.stop: Terminal reason and evidence-state digest; it is rejected if any proposal lacks an observation/failure/unknown reconciliation event.

integrity_rules: Events use zero-based contiguous sequence numbers and a previous-event SHA-256 chain.
Event digest covers canonical JSON for event ID, sequence, event type, previous digest and payload; the digest field itself is excluded.
Proposal event IDs and experiment IDs are unique; every observation references one prior proposal exactly once.
Observed, failed and unknown attempts are all recorded; missing outcomes are not silently dropped.

Predicted selection score must match the selector's dimensional contract: EIG score = EIG bits; EVSI score = EVSI minus cost; risk-adjusted EVSI score = EVSI minus cost minus risk_aversion*predicted_risk.
No new experiment proposals or observations are permitted after stop.
prospective_experiment_trace.trust_boundary: A self-contained hash chain detects changes relative to a trusted checkpoint but does not prove event time or signer identity. Model-run use requires an independently operated append-only recorder that signs or timestamps the proposal digest before the experiment is executed.
prospective_experiment_trace.claim_ceiling: The current module computes proper scores for small categorical forecasts from supplied evaluator-resolved labels and validates internal trace consistency. It does not establish real-world calibration, forecast honesty, event time, signer identity or external data correctness. Those require held-out model trials, independent observation adjudication and external timestamp/signature anchoring.

metrics.brier_score: For observed outcomes, sum squared differences across the preregistered categorical outcome space between predicted probabilities and one-hot evaluator-resolved outcome. Lower is better.
metrics.log_loss: For observed outcomes with nonzero forecast probability, -ln(probability assigned to the observed class). An observed zero-probability class is represented as infinite/unavailable log loss and counted separately; no silent epsilon clipping.
metrics.denominator: Only completed observations with an independently resolved outcome class enter Brier/log-loss denominators. Failed/unknown attempts remain visible and receive separate counts; they are not silently discarded.
metrics.adjudication: Observed outcome class must be determined from the immutable observation by the independent evaluator, under a predeclared outcome taxonomy. The model does not choose its own realized label.
